description.sv: Sheffields årliga "House Comp" på The House Skatepark — norra Englands mest regelbundna skatetävling, med klasser för Under 16, damer, över 16 och proffs.
description.en: Sheffield's annual "House Comp" at The House Skatepark — the north of England's most regular skateboarding competition, with Under 16, women's, over-16 and pro categories.

source.note: Confirmed via The House Skatepark's own site (thehouseskatepark.co.uk) and the Skateboard GB events listing: Saturday 12th September 2026, 10am until 'around 6'. This is a mixed-level event (12-and-under jam through to pro/sponsored categories) — level set to "pro" since it includes a pro category, but it's genuinely open to multiple levels; verify against your schema if that matters for filtering. Postcode varies slightly between sources (S3 8AS on an older SBGB page vs S3 8AU on the venue's own current site) — coordinates are Sheffield-city-level approximations, not the exact venue pin.
